-
Someone with excellent communication skills, particularly with executive-level partners

-

10+ years of experience in a Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Strategy and/or Finance role in B2B SaaS (software-as-a-service) environments

-
Ability to lead through influence, working alongside organizational leadership (Sales, Operations, Product Management, and Executive Team)

-
Proven track record of leading change management, building aligned tooling and developing methods to measure and systemize Sales KPIs for internal teams and customers.

-
Proven track record in operational excellence, automation and process resilience.

-
High motivation for continuous improvement and ability to drive impact in a fast-paced environment. Ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment with a high degree of autonomy

Spearheading the operationalization and execution of strategic programs and projects aligned with R&D's quarterly and annual initiatives.

-

Assume responsibility and accountability for a diverse portfolio of projects aimed at advancing R&D objectives. Serve as a strategic partner to stakeholders, leveraging industry knowledge to inform project and initiative decisions.

Performance Metrics and Reporting

Develop and implement robust metrics and measurement frameworks to assess the effectiveness and progress of programs and projects within the portfolio. Regularly report on key performance indicators, providing insights and recommendations for improvement. Collaborate closely with R&D leaders and stakeholders to align initiatives with overarching business strategy and drive tangible business outcomes.

Strategic Leadership

Spearhead efforts to foster strategic alignment among R&D teams and stakeholders, ensuring cohesive progress towards both R&D and OneTrust objectives. Offer insightful analysis and thought leadership on key issues impacting program and project success, encompassing considerations of scope, timeline, and quality requirements. Serve as a trusted advisor to the R&D team, providing clear guidance on program and project outcomes when obstacles arise.

Problem-solving and Clarity

Assume direct responsibility and accountability for guiding R&D transformations essential for achieving program and project objectives, with a keen awareness of both immediate and long-term repercussions. Offer informed recommendations on program dependencies that could impact the success of other projects or initiatives within the project portfolio or broader R&D initiatives.

Risk Management

-
Communication Proficiency: Excels in conveying information clearly and succinctly to both leadership and stakeholders, adept at setting expectations and identifying and addressing misalignments. Capable of engaging in critical conversations across diverse stakeholders, including project teams and executive management.

-

-

-

-

-
Collaboration: A highly collaborative team player who adeptly navigates diverse personalities, fosters productive working relationships, and shares insights and knowledge gained from project experiences.

-
Outcome Orientation: Takes ownership of individual and team success, modeling integrity and accountability in all interactions with colleagues and clients alike.

-
Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in project/program management, demonstrating a track record of leading cross-functional teams to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and address emerging needs.

-
Proven ability to influence executive leadership and establish clear expectations for major cross-functional initiatives.

-
Successfully employed organizational change management practices to drive impactful business outcomes.

-
PMP certification or equivalent preferred, showcasing a commitment to professional development and alignment to industry-recognized best practices in [Agile] project management.

Extra Awesome

-
Program Management experience from ideation / planning through execution and delivery of SaaS solutions as part of an overall software development lifecycle (SDLC).

This is a highly visible, customer-facing leadership role responsible for accelerating customer value, improving product quality, influencing product strategy, and driving measurable business outcomes across OneTrust's most strategic accounts.

As a member of the Design Partner Program, you will operate at the intersection of Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership. You will partner directly with customer executives, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams to identify business priorities, unblock complex technical challenges, advocate for customer needs, and ensure strategic customer investments translate into long-term product improvements.

Success in this role means helping customers achieve faster time-to-value, increasing adoption of strategic capabilities, reducing operational friction, improving product quality, and turning customer insights into roadmap investments that benefit both the customer and the broader market.

Your Mission

Lead Strategic Customer Partnerships: Own executive relationships across a portfolio of strategic Design Partner customers. Align business objectives, product strategy, and technical execution to deliver measurable customer outcomes. Facilitate executive reviews, success planning, milestone governance, and strategic alignment. Serve as the trusted advisor for product adoption, transformation initiatives, and customer success.

Drive Customer Outcomes and Business Value: Build customer success plans focused on adoption, business impact, operational efficiency, and risk reduction. Measure and communicate value realization through executive-ready business reviews and outcome tracking. Identify barriers to adoption and coordinate cross-functional remediation plans. Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, expansion opportunities, and product utilization.

Be the Voice of the Customer: Synthesize customer feedback, product gaps, adoption challenges, escalations, and enhancement requests into actionable insights. Partner with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities and investment decisions. Translate customer pain points into strategic recommendations backed by business impact and customer evidence. Establish closed-loop feedback mechanisms to ensure customer concerns lead to measurable product improvements.

Drive Program Execution: Own engagement plans, customer milestones, risks, dependencies, and success metrics. Coordinate execution across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Customer Success, Support, and GTM teams. Facilitate escalation management, executive decision-making, and cross-functional alignment.
